<thought>The 13C NMR list shows 13 signals. The downfield carbonyl at 166 ppm and the aliphatic signals at 61.10 ppm and 14.26 ppm are not aromatic. The remaining 11 signals (151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 ×2, 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, 116.65 ×2) fall in the typical aromatic region, indicating 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
